confirmation_policy: All Train is previously studied development evidence; no unseen holdout. Historical Valid / Valid prohibited, including saved artifacts.

feature_definitions.SN1_H1: Original dm_variable_box_breakout feature/bidirectional/sn1 path and annual H1 Ridge unchanged; replay original base EWMA inversion, High=.25 Low=.50, Low precedence. All breakout/horizon/model parameters unchanged.
feature_definitions.SLOW_CONTROL: Original dm_slow_multifactor build_features(sector=False).size_liquidity unchanged: global normalized size/amihud, trailing60/min40, 1/99 winsor/median/z; no smoothing.
feature_definitions.rank: Per-date average percentile rank p, center mean(p), return 2*(p-mean(p)); same original centered_rank. Identical scale in both components; singleton/all ties zero. Average ties before official first tie break by sorted Code.
feature_definitions.SN1_SLOW_BLEND: centered_rank(SN1_H1 final score)+centered_rank(SLOW_CONTROL final score), fixed 1:1, no further EWMA; official five-quintile ranking.
feature_definitions.PURE_WEIGHT_50_50: diagnostic only: .5*SN1 official weight+.5*SLOW official weight. Cost .001*abs(diff(net combined weight)) on full continuous panel. Also separate .5*component sleeve cost P/L as non-netted diagnostic; neither a submission candidate.

model: One fixed, label-free score combination of two immutable components; no tuning
selection_rule: Conjunction of all user criteria vs SLOW_CONTROL; no rescue. Annual net and MDD compared pooled and ex2016; Long/Short and turnover gates pooled and ex2016. Primary bootstrap pooled lower95>0; ex2016 bootstrap also saved descriptive.

bootstrap.method: paired circular moving-block on concatenated eligible sessions; ddof=1 annualized Sharpe

orthogonality.scores: daily Spearman average ties, aggregate mean and HAC5
orthogonality.membership: official Long Q4/Q5 and Short Q1/Q2; intersection/min(set sizes), directional intersection/set size and Jaccard; continuous weights
orthogonality.sector: exact contemporaneous PIT33, UNKNOWN separate; each-day cross-sector exposure Pearson and each-sector across-date Pearson, separate Long/Short
orthogonality.drawdown: compounded net wealth with initial1; underwater<0, intersection/union Jaccard and conditional rates, episodes, depths Pearson; no threshold search
orthogonality.loss_days: net<0 strict; both, exactly one, neither; conditional other Net means

attribution.partition: disagreement priority (opposite official sides); bothLong, SN1-onlyLong(otherNeutral), SLOW-onlyLong(otherNeutral), bothShort, SN1-onlyShort(otherNeutral), SLOW-onlyShort(otherNeutral), bothNeutral residual for exit costs. Also inclusive marginal memberships saved, overlaps explicitly marked.
attribution.measures: stock-day count, finite target count/mean, daily target mean, gross/net/turnover/cost for all3 books plus deltas vs each component; full official panel before date eligibility, exit charges retained; .001 charged only finite targets, all-position costs separate
